Elliot (partner-eng): Quick sync — Sputnik Systems agreed to run a small alpha hardware validation next week under NDA. Need to confirm telemetry hooks, minimal runner, and which benchmarks to ask them to run. They requested the lightest possible instructions.
Ava Liu: Do we have the NDA countersigned? If so please drop contact and any access creds.
partners-bot: NDA countersigned by Sputnik Systems (contact: nina@sputnik-sys.com) — uploaded to shared drive: https://redwoodinternal/sputnik/nda.pdf
Miguel Torres: I can own the runner. My ask: request throughput @ seq=1024, p50/p99 latency, and warm vs cold KV-cache perf. Minimal command to run: `./run_bench --model rdx-3b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --metrics p50,p99,throughput`
Ravi Patel: Also capture GPU perf counters (util, mem, power) and export logs as jsonl. We should provide an ansible snippet to install our telemetry agent and a sample `telemetry.yaml`.
Priya Nair: +1. Also ask them to run 10 short eval prompts (we'll provide) to sanity-check generation quality vs hosted baseline. Keep sample steerable so we catch tokenization regressions.
Elliot (partner-eng): I'll share the 10 seed prompts and the runner script by EOD. Miguel — can you add a small config toggle for quantization and bf16/float16 runs?
Miguel Torres: Yep, I'll push `bench/configs/sputnik_minimal.yaml` to the drive and tag @Elliot. ETA tomorrow morning :coffee:
Ravi Patel: For Dedicated SKU benchmarking, note when fallback routing would trigger and include the capacity/slot config. We'll set a 99%ile latency target baseline and flag violations in the results.
Priya Nair: Also a quick legal/PR note — this is strictly alpha. No public comms until legal signs off on partner messaging and we finish internal validation. Marking embargo.
Elliot (partner-eng): Agreed, embargoed. I'll draft a short partner runbook (install steps, runner command, telemetry checklist, contact matrix) and share the drive link once it's up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
